$comment: R4.6 BASELINE STERILITY — the CLI's OWN built-in agents/skills/slash_commands, per version.
Claude Code ships these inside the binary; no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR can remove them, which is why
the original 'these arrays must be empty' predicate was unsatisfiable (docs/decisions.md,
2026-07-29 R4.6 amendment). Purity now means SET EQUALITY with the entry for the version the
session reported: anything extra is a leak and aborts naming it, anything missing means this
is not the pinned CLI and aborts as a version mismatch.
HOW THIS WAS CAPTURED (2026-07-29): by running the harness's own sterile-session path —
createSterileConfigDir (settings.json + exactly one credential, R3.3/R3.4) + scrubEnvironment
(R3.7) + runSession — against a sandbox whose ancestor chain is clean, and reading the sets
straight off the streamed system/init event. The CLI's OAuth token is expired on this machine,
and the init event still arrives before the 401: the transcript is
init -> api_retry -> api_retry -> assistant -> result('...401 OAuth access token has expired').
It matches the init recorded by live-run attempt 3 (C:\bp-runs\2026-07-29T10-56-34-241Z_B_52fecbe).
MEASURED SENSITIVITY, recorded because it decides what this manifest is valid FOR: the sets
move with things the harness already pins, so they are stable only under the harness's own
preconditions.  Same binary, same machine, same day:
· sterile dir + one credential + scrubbed env  -> 5 agents / 14 skills / 27 commands  (THIS FILE)
· sterile dir + NO credential + scrubbed env   -> 5 / 13 / 26   ('schedule' is entitlement-gated)
· sterile dir + NO credential + INHERITED env  -> 6 / 13 / 26   (adds the 'claude-code-guide' agent)
R3.4 guarantees exactly one credential or aborts, and R3.7 always scrubs, so a harness run only
ever sees the first row. A run that somehow sees another one is not the measured configuration
and SHOULD abort loudly — that is the version-mismatch branch doing its job, not a false alarm.
capturedFrom: sterile probe via scripts/roundtrip sandbox.mjs + claude-session.mjs (cli-credentials auth, scrubbed env)
